description: This file defines the ProductStoreWorker class, which provides utility methods for managing product store related functionalities such as retrieving store info, handling shipping, surveys, inventory checks, and payment settings within the OFBiz e-commerce framework.

classes.name: ProductStoreWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing store-related functions such as retrieving store information, handling shipping options, surveys, inventory checks, and payment configurations within the OFBiz environment.

methods.name: getProductStore
methods.description: Retrieves the ProductStore entity by its ID using a delegator.

methods.name: getProductStore(ServletRequest)
methods.description: Fetches the current product store based on request session attributes or website configuration.

methods.name: getProductStoreId
methods.description: Obtains the product store ID from session or website data within the request.

methods.name: getStoreCurrencyUomId
methods.description: Gets the default currency UOM ID for the store based on the request context.

methods.name: getStoreLocale
methods.description: Returns the store's locale setting based on the request.

methods.name: getStoreTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the store's timezone setting based on the request.

methods.name: determineSingleFacilityForStore
methods.description: Determines if the store uses a single inventory facility based on its configuration.

methods.name: autoSaveCart
methods.description: Checks whether the store configuration permits auto-saving the cart.

methods.name: getProductStorePayToPartyId
methods.description: Retrieves the pay-to party ID for a specific product store.

methods.name: getProductStorePaymentProperties
methods.description: Fetches payment property settings for the store given payment method details.

methods.name: getProductStorePaymentSetting
methods.description: Retrieves the payment setting entity for a specific payment configuration.

methods.name: getProductStoreShipmentMethods
methods.description: Lists shipment methods available for the store based on filtering parameters.

methods.name: getProductStoreShipmentMethod
methods.description: Retrieves a specific shipment method for the store.

methods.name: getAvailableStoreShippingMethods
methods.description: Calculates and returns applicable shipping methods for given address, items, and constraints.

methods.name: getRandomSurveyWrapper
methods.description: Selects and returns a random product store survey wrapper for the current store and user session.

methods.name: getSurveys
methods.description: Retrieves surveys associated with a product store with various filtering options.

methods.name: checkSurveyResponse
methods.description: Returns the count of responses for a specified survey and party.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryRequired
methods.description: Checks if inventory is required for a product in the store.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the specified product has available inventory in the store.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryRequiredAndAvailable
methods.description: Determines whether inventory is both required and available for the product.

methods.name: isStoreInventoryAvailable(String, ProductConfigWrapper, BigDecimal, Delegator, LocalDispatcher)
methods.description: Evaluates inventory availability for specific catalog and product configurations.
